purpose: Select the first 3-5 SKUs for a reusable SKU Source Passport delivery.

selection_policy.selection_rule: Choose the highest-scoring SKUs that have sufficient official evidence and meaningful buying questions.
disqualification_rules: No official or customer-approved canonical product page.
No evidence for key product facts.
Buying questions depend on price, inventory, ratings, reviews, promotions, or rankings.
Customer cannot approve limitations or compatibility boundaries.
SKU is discontinued or unavailable for source-page maintenance unless explicitly approved as an archive case.

scoring_dimensions.label: Official evidence depth
scoring_dimensions.score_3: One official source with partial facts.
scoring_dimensions.score_5: Product, support, manual, FAQ, or certification evidence covers identity, specs, compatibility, and limitations.

scoring_dimensions.label: Buying decision value
scoring_dimensions.score_3: Some choice, comparison, or compatibility questions.
scoring_dimensions.score_5: Many high-intent questions can be answered without prohibited commerce fields.

scoring_dimensions.label: Fact stability
scoring_dimensions.score_0: Facts change too frequently for a stable source pack.
scoring_dimensions.score_3: Most facts are stable, with some review-needed fields.
scoring_dimensions.score_5: Identity, specs, compatibility, requirements, and limitations are stable and source-backed.

scoring_dimensions.label: Comparison clarity
scoring_dimensions.score_3: Comparison points exist but need human approval.
scoring_dimensions.score_5: Clear factual comparison points exist across selected SKUs or approved alternatives.

scoring_dimensions.label: Limitation clarity
scoring_dimensions.score_5: Limitations, not-for scenarios, and compatibility boundaries are clear.

scoring_dimensions.label: Weekly maintenance fit
scoring_dimensions.score_3: Weekly monitor can detect brand, SKU, and core fact coverage.
scoring_dimensions.score_5: Weekly monitor can detect citation, wrong facts, missing limitations, and weak comparisons.

candidate_sku_template.review_notes: Explain why this SKU should be selected, deferred, or rejected.
